resources.string:
Access Control is a parental-control service that helps a parent and child agree on safe device use. This device will be monitored ONLY after you complete pairing with a parent account and grant the listed permissions.

 What may be collected, with your knowledge:
 • App list and daily app usage time (requires Usage Access permission)
 • Device status: battery, charging, network, model, Android version
 • Location — ONLY while the parent enables location monitoring AND location permission is granted. Status is always visible on the dashboard.
 • App restriction policies (screen-time limits, app limits, schedules)

 What is NEVER done:
 • No keylogging, no reading of passwords or messages
 • No microphone or camera recording
 • No secret screen recording
 • No execution of arbitrary remote commands

 Consent & control:
 • The app icon can be hidden only through an explicit setting you choose, and the app stays reachable by dialing *#*#9999#*#* and through the parent dashboard.
 • Device-admin (uninstall protection) is optional and clearly disclosed. It can be deactivated from Settings → Device admin.
 • A parent can revoke this device from the dashboard, which disconnects it permanently.

 By pressing I Agree you confirm you are the device guardian and accept these terms.
Ask your parent to generate a code in the dashboard, then type it here.
Not required on this Android version
Grant precise location first, then allow all the time
Used only to detect which app is in the foreground so app limits and instant block work immediately. No screen content is read.
Screen sharing is active — your parent can see this device's screen.
Microphone sharing is active — your parent can hear this device's surroundings.
Camera sharing is active — your parent can see the camera view.
Your parent requested screen sharing. Tap to allow (system dialog will appear).
Your parent requested one-way audio. Tap to allow.
Your parent requested remote camera access. Tap to allow.
To open the app again, dial *#*#9999#*#* in the phone app, or ask your parent. The app keeps working in the background.
Ask your parent for more time on this app.
Keeping this device protected according to family policies.
Allows Access Control to protect this child device: lock the screen during bedtime/school mode and warn before uninstalling the protection. Deactivate any time from Settings.

Access Control uses device-admin to (1) lock the screen when a schedule like bedtime is active and (2) make uninstalling the protection a deliberate step. It cannot read messages and cannot prevent you from contacting anyone in an emergency.
